_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», el cuaderno de primeras palabras en inglés, ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO (se regeneran con `make generate`). Cada palabra va partida en sus sonidos con guiones («v-a-n», «sh-ee-p»; la e mágica, «c-a_e-k»), y tiene que coincidir con el partido automático de tools/fonetica.py; los nombres que se leen de un golpe (Amy, Toby) van enteros. Los mismos temas, semana a semana, que «Read and Draw» (content/english/). Trimestre 1 (otoño), días 1-65: una palabra al día; semanas 1-5, una letra = un sonido (cat, Pip); desde la semana 6, también ck, ff, ll, ss, zz, gg, x, y, qu.

actividad.prompt: A big van stops next to Lucía's house. Draw the van. What is in it?
The new neighbours are here! Turn the circle into the face of their mum.
Pip, the green parrot, in his big cage.
Amy at her door. She has got curly red hair.
Draw the house next door, with the new neighbours at the windows.
Today Amy starts at Lucía's school. Draw her school bag: it is purple, with a yellow star on it.
Amy and Lucía, sitting side by side in class.
three pens: a red one, a blue one and a green one.

actividad.adivinanza: I am green, I live in a cage next door, and I say “Hello!” to everyone. Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía and Amy at school: two new friends.
This is Toby, Lucía's dog. He is brown and he has got long ears. Draw him on the grass, next to the fence.
Toby is a dog! Turn the arc into Toby's back, and draw the rest of him: his head, his legs and his tail.
Toby wagging his tail at the fence. But only Pip is there!
Toby, very tired, having a nap on the grass.
Draw Toby on the grass and Pip in his cage, with the fence between them.
Amy comes to Lucía's house. Lucía's bed is under the window, and it has got a yellow blanket. Draw it.
Dad reading on the sofa, with Toby asleep in his basket.
Toby's red ball, under Lucía's bed -- as always!

actividad.adivinanza: I am soft and brown, I have got two round ears, and I sit on Lucía's bed. She gives me a hug every night. Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw your bedroom. What is on your bed?
Sam is Amy's little brother. In the park, he jumps in the leaves with Dani. Draw them in a big pile of red and yellow leaves.
Amy finds shiny brown nuts under a big tree: conkers! Turn the oval into a conker.
Lucía's autumn picture: a tree with orange leaves, and a yellow sun behind it.
Sam in his warm hat, because his ears are cold.
Draw the park in autumn: a big tree, a pond and three brown ducks.
Grandma Rosa comes to visit! She is knitting a long scarf for Dani, with green and blue stripes. Draw her.
Amy eating her first roasted chestnut: sweet and hot!
the clock in Grandma's story, and the little mouse who lives in it. Tick, tock!

actividad.adivinanza: I am long and soft. I have got green and blue stripes and two red pompoms, and Grandma is making me for Dani. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw Dani in his new scarf, and Toby trying to catch the pompoms.
It is Halloween! Lucía is a black cat with long whiskers. Draw her costume.
Turn the zigzag into the wings of a bat, flying past the moon.
the sweets that Amy gets at Halloween: ten of them!
Pip yelling “Boo!” at the door -- and everybody jumping!
Draw the pumpkin lantern: two triangle eyes, a big smile and a yellow light inside.
It rains all week. Lucía zips up her red raincoat and puts on her yellow wellies. Draw her going to school in the rain.
Toby rolling in the mud. Now he needs a bath!
ducks swimming in a big puddle. Quack, quack!

actividad.adivinanza: On Bonfire Night, I go up into the sky with a fizz and a bang, and I am full of colours. Toby hides under the sofa when he hears me. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the jumping competition in the puddles. Who jumps the highest?
Today is Lucía's birthday: she is eight! Draw her birthday cake, with eight candles and three strawberries.
Turn the square into a present for Lucía. What is in the box?
Lucía blowing out her eight candles: puff!
Grandma Rosa giving Lucía a big birthday kiss.
Draw Lucía's party: everyone has got a paper hat -- even Toby!
At the vet's, there are animals that are sick: a white rabbit, a tortoise in a box and a small grey kitten. Draw them.
Mrs Brown checking Toby. He is a bit fat, so no more biscuits!
the white rabbit with a bad ear, and Mrs Brown helping it.

actividad.adivinanza: I help sick animals: dogs, cats, rabbits and parrots. Mrs Brown is one, and Amy wants to be one too. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw an animal that you would like to help, like a vet.
Mr Brown makes an English breakfast: two eggs, three sausages, beans and toast. Draw it on a big plate!
Turn the circle into Mr Brown's frying pan, with two eggs in it.
a warm scone with jam and cream.
the children mixing the flour and the butter in a big bowl.
Draw Dani with cream on his nose, and Sam laughing.
Luna is Pedro's cat. She is white, with one green eye and one blue eye. Draw her on the fence, with her red collar.
Luna's red collar, with its little bell.
Pip's cage, hanging up high, where Luna can't reach it.

actividad.adivinanza: I am white, I have got one green eye and one blue eye, and I sit on the fence all day. Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw Luna and Pip playing their game with two little bells.
It is nearly Christmas! Amy makes six Christmas cards, with a snowman on each one. Draw them.
Turn the triangle into a Christmas tree, with a big yellow star at the top.
a big red Christmas sock, like the one that Amy hangs up for Father Christmas.
Amy is staying in Spain for Christmas: yes! Lucía and Amy, jumping for joy.
Draw the Christmas show: Lucía and Amy singing “Jingle Bells” on the stage.
